en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a ceremonial entrance of royals and dignitaries into a large marble stadium packed with spectators. People in formal military uniforms and elegant early‑20th‑century dress walk along the track toward the infield. The architecture suggests a horseshoe‑shaped classical stadium with stone seating rising on both sides and a colonnade at the far end. Printed captions in Greek, French, and English appear along the bottom margin, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) is visible over the image.
